name: oauth-consent-nextjs-ssr
title: OAuth Consent
description: Supabase OAuth 2.1 authorization consent page with approve and deny actions.
docs: Requires NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY. Enable the OAuth server in supabase/config.toml under [auth.oauth_server] and set authorization_url_path = "/oauth/consent".
